connector.name: Temway
connector.registryDescription: Visual email & layout builder that turns AI assistants into a Temway authoring studio.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.temway.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the temway account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Temway API key (starts with 'tmw_live_'), minted by a team admin in the Temway dashboard. Send as 'Bearer tmw_live_…'. For hosted web connectors (claude.ai, ChatGPT) OAuth 2.1 (PKCE/S256) is also supported — no header needed.
